Vahnidaivata : nt.: Name of the nakṣatra Kṛttikā (whose regent is god fire).

Events:

(1) Epic: Kṛṣṇā (Draupadī) bore a son Śrutasena by Sahadeva under the constellation Vahnidaivata (nakṣatre vahnidaivate) 1. 213. 78;

(2) Mythological: When the Kṛttikās went to the heaven to fill in the gap caused by the dropping down of Abhijit, they began to shine there as the Vahnidaivata nakṣatra having the shape of a cart (tridivaṁ kṛttikā gatāḥ/nakṣatraṁ śakaṭākāraṁ bhāti tad vahnidaivatam) 3. 219. 11. [See Āgneya, Kṛttikā ]

Vāhīka : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the Northern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of Bhāratavarṣa (ata ūrdhvaṁ janapadān nibodha) 6. 10. 37, 5; (vāhīkā vāṭadhānāś ca) 6. 10. 45.
